note: Official national (or system) peak demand for the country-scale sweep. The latest complete year is used: 2025 where the operator published it, else 2024, as `year` states. `comparable` is `yes` where the reference's scope matches the generated region closely enough to score within ±25%, `flag` where the figure is shown but not scored, and `no` where it measures something else. Figures from time series (GB, ERCOT, Brazil) are maxima of the operator's published data.

prt.scope: Mainland public-grid demand, 15-minute (REN); excludes the Azores and Madeira and behind-the-meter self-consumption
prt.model_scope: Mainland Portugal; the Azores and Madeira are cut as far islands or left out as too small for a bus

esp.scope: Peninsular hourly demand at power-station busbars (REE); excludes the Balearic and Canary Islands
esp.model_scope: Peninsular Spain and the Balearic Islands; the Canaries are cut as far islands

deu.scope: Country hourly total load (ENTSO-E, the SMARD Netzlast series)

fra.scope: National gross consumption, consolidated (RTE); metropolitan France
fra.model_scope: Metropolitan France with Corsica; the overseas departments are cut as far islands
fra.source: RTE, annual peak of gross consumption (data.gouv.fr)

gbr.scope: Great Britain: transmission National Demand plus NESO's estimates of embedded wind and solar, half-hourly maximum (9 Jan 2025); Northern Ireland, about 1.8 GW, is not included
gbr.model_scope: The United Kingdom polygon, Northern Ireland included

texas-box.scope: ERCOT region hourly integrated native load
texas-box.model_scope: A bounding box around Texas that also takes in parts of Mexico, New Mexico, Oklahoma and Louisiana, and El Paso, which is outside ERCOT

usa.scope: Lower-48 coincident hourly demand over the balancing authorities (EIA-930); 2025 value preliminary
usa.model_scope: The United States after the far-island policy (Alaska and Hawaii cut)

ind.scope: All-India peak demand met (30 May 2024). No 2025 annual figure is published; ministerial statements put 2025 near 241-243 GW

chn.scope: National total maximum load, all grids (NEA, 17 Jul 2025)
chn.model_scope: China (Natural Earth's CHN polygon, which leaves out Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao)

rus.scope: UES of Russia; excludes the technologically isolated systems
rus.model_scope: Russia with its isolated eastern systems; one far polygon is cut

bra.scope: SIN instantaneous load (ONS), including estimated behind-the-meter distributed generation

jpn.scope: National coincident peak of the 10 areas, hourly, sending end (OCCTO draft verification report, 22 Oct 2025)

aus.scope: No national figure exists. NEM operational demand 33,716 MW (16 Dec 2024) plus WEM 4,233 MW (18 Feb 2024): a non-coincident sum that leaves out rooftop PV and the off-grid systems
aus.model_scope: Australia with Tasmania as one AC island; the NEM and Western Australia are joined
aus.source: AEMO Quarterly Energy Dynamics Q4 2024 and Q1 2024

zaf.scope: Eskom total peak demand on the integrated power system, financial year April 2024 to March 2025; no 2025 figure is published

nga.scope: National grid peak generation (4 Mar 2025): supply-limited, not demand

egy.scope: Unified national grid peak load (13 Aug 2025)
egy.source: Ministry of Electricity via Amwal Al Ghad

chl.model_scope: Chile; small islands are left out
chl.source: Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional, Reporte Energético enero 2026

idn.scope: Sum of the individual PLN system peaks, not coincident (Java-Bali alone 42,636 MW); no 2025 figure was retrievable
idn.model_scope: Indonesia as one AC island over 26 landmasses; one far polygon is cut
